title: Fieldcast: Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Run, VPC-SC
proves: No AWS labels; security captured; Disaster Recovery reported Missing when not discussed.
transcript:
Okay, let's start. I'm handing over Fieldcast, the telemetry ingestion service for our IoT sensors, around nine hundred million events a day.
Devices publish to Pub/Sub. A Dataflow job enriches the events and writes them to BigQuery, and raw payloads are archived in Cloud Storage.
The query API runs on Cloud Run and reads from BigQuery and a Memorystore cache. Device metadata is in Cloud SQL for Postgres.
Everything is in Terraform, and Cloud Build deploys to Cloud Run on every merge to main. To roll back, shift traffic to the previous Cloud Run revision.
We watch Cloud Monitoring dashboards; the key alert is Pub/Sub oldest unacked message age over ten minutes, which pages through Opsgenie.
The common failure is Dataflow falling behind after a schema change; the fix is to drain the job and redeploy with the updated schema.
Do not delete the BigQuery raw dataset; it is the only copy for the compliance team.
Service accounts use least privilege and VPC Service Controls protect BigQuery.
The data platform team owns Dataflow. Ask Tomasz Kowalski for anything about the device firmware.
Still open: the cost review for BigQuery storage has no owner yet.
